svg.title: AXIOM COMPUTE | Software, Computing and Infrastructure
svg.desc: AXIOM COMPUTE engineering and project showcase. Application development, AI and automation, computing and infrastructure. Project focus: AXIOM AI and INFINITY TRACK. Precision. Performance. Reliability. A detailed server cabinet features neatly routed orange Ethernet cables with animated data pulses.

g.text: Engineering the systems behind your ideas.
We develop applications, build computing solutions,
and design the infrastructure that connects them.
A local AI platform for coding, research,
Android and web software connecting BLE
trackers with a central command interface.
